Stage setup drag operates independently
Wizard guides opening, effect and duration; only completion makes the screen hot
Push/Pull card overlays the player with percent, seconds and plain speed choices
Rotation must be enabled before a second finger can rotate

Joystick starts Action; center, travel, release, cancellation and reacquisition are stable
Joystick supports keyboard direction without sticky movement
Mobile layout 320px
Mobile layout 390px
Mobile layout 430px
Touch Action, first/second finger roles, radial separation, promotion and no-jump reacquisition
Zoom and rotation hold while master Action continues
Pause unlocks navigation
Button Action, partial replacement, inherited boundary and automatic endpoint
Original Scribe frame mark, recoverable Clear and History
Review returns to normal speed and original audio level
Offline MP4 render uses saved path without re-performance
Encoded frame count and normal-speed duration
Rendered pixels match saved composition; no UI overlay at 0s
Rendered pixels match saved composition; no UI overlay at 0.4s
Rendered pixels match saved composition; no UI overlay at 0.92s
Source audio synchronized to nonzero opening
Completely outside source renders intentional black; WebM works
Joystick performance renders from its exact saved path with no joystick overlay
